period_note: Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site. From this vintage onward DSE no longer publishes Turnover/Revenue or Profit-in-BDT on this page (the rows are present in the page's HTML but wrapped in a comment, rendering only placeholder zeros) -- only EPS and period-end market price remain, matching the identical presentation change already documented for RUPALIBANK from its own 2023 capture onward. Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). Q3's DISCRETE Basic EPS is specifically NOT disclosed by the source (shown as a dash) even though the 9-Months CUMULATIVE EPS and Q3's own period-end market price both ARE given -- a genuine sub-gap, not a full quarter gap. A naive subtraction (9M 7.580 - HY 3.730 = 3.850) is arithmetically possible but is NOT recorded as a line item here, since this same table's own Q1+Q2-vs-HY gap this year (see 2024_Q2.json) already shows an internal inconsistency that undermines confidence in a simple subtraction -- recording it would risk presenting a fabricated-looking precision this dataset's 'don't fabricate a number to fill a hole' rule is meant to avoid.
